Social Fabric

Whether you’re stopping in for a coffee to-go, a meeting with a college or to spend time with a friend, SOCIAL FABRIC will greet you with hospitality, warmth and a smile. Tutta Bella

Buon Appetito! We're Tutta Bella. Born in Naples. Raised in Seattle. We believe in doing Italian food the right way, using simple, high quality ingredients to create beautiful flavors that honor our Neapolitan roots and celebrate our vibrant Puget Sound surroundings.

![Lobby Bar](https://renseattle.com/assets/images/cache/lobby1-ce02051239bbeafd5609fc76598028f6.png "Lobby Bar")

Lobby Bar

The Lobby Bar at REN is an oasis of refinement and relaxation, beckoning guests to unwind and indulge in the art of socializing. Plush furnishings, ambient lighting, and sleek design exude an air of sophistication, while our expert mixologists craft masterful cocktails with precision and flair. Our team transforms simple ingredients into complex, unforgettable concoctions. Each drink is a work of art, with flavors that linger long after the last sip.

# Recommended attractions and establishments near REN in Seattle, WA

Experience the pinnacle of luxury and convenience at our premier location. Not only will you find top-tier accommodations and amenities, but you’ll also have the opportunity to explore our onsite retailers. **The Lobby Bar** offers a sophisticated atmosphere where you can unwind with a curated selection of drinks. For a unique shopping experience, visit **Social Fabric**, where you’ll discover bespoke items and local artisanal food & drink. Together, they provide a seamless blend of relaxation and retail therapy right at your fingertips. 

Rising from Denny Triangle, one of Seattle’s fastest growing neighborhoods, REN is central to the best of the city—Downtown, Belltown, South Lake Union and Capitol Hill are all within walking distance. The Amazon Spheres and Fifth Avenue shops are less than a 10-minute stroll or 5-minute drive away.
